name: OmaShaders
author: AktOn1
description: Brand new (two weeks old, expect rough edges). One bar icon opens menus for over 100 screen and window GPU shaders, 130+ colour grades, about 170 animated wallpaper effects with a mouse-reaction slider, 50+ cursor effects and 183 ready-made themes. Hover to preview, strength slider per effect (starts readable), favourites, pause key, GPU use.

barWidget.description: Click to open the menu: pick a complete theme first, then open the parts you want to tweak (Screen, Color, Wallpaper, Cursor, Windows). Hover to preview, Enter to keep, [ ] to adjust strength, p to pause everything. Right-click turns effects off, scroll steps the screen shader.

schema.label: Frame rate of wallpaper and cursor effects
Cursor effects and wallpaper mouse reactions only while Shift is held (needs a Hyprland Shift_L binding, see README)
Key that pauses / resumes every effect from anywhere, e.g. when the screen has gone black (Hyprland format: CTRL + ALT + P; empty = no key; a key another program already uses is never taken)
Menu layout (New: themes first; Classic: the older Screen, Color, Wallpaper, Cursor, Windows, Combos columns)
Use theme wallpaper when available (applying a theme that remembers a Wallhaven picture downloads it if needed and sets it as the wallpaper; off = applying a theme never touches your wallpaper)

AI tool for “Create your own theme” (the theme dialog lists only the tools installed here and remembers its last pick; changing this sets it; with “Remembered choice” and no pick yet it starts with the agent set by `omarchy default agent`)
AI model (empty = the tool's own default; any model id the tool or endpoint accepts)
Custom AI command (used when the AI tool is “Custom command”; it gets the prompt on stdin and prints text containing one JSON object; see README)
